title: Integer claim keys
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 4. Step 3 — Build the CWT claim set; QR Code Generation, 5. Step 4 — Serialise as CBOR; QR Code Generation, 12.4 The payload; HCERT Specification, 3.2.1 CWT Structure Overview.

statements.label: Integer claim keys
statements.requirement: The CWT claim set SHALL use the integer keys 1 (iss), 6 (iat), 4 (exp) and -260 (hcert). The hcert map SHALL use integer subclaim keys. The quoted keys in the documentation ("1", "-260", "-6") are JSON notation only and SHALL NOT be emitted as text keys.

successCriteria.criterion: PR 129 example as a conformance vector (req:stt-tst-001) passes.

sources.quote: Place the payload under its subclaim, inside the hcert claim, inside a CWT claim set
